walkthroughs.body_html: On 9 November 1989, SED official Gunter Schabowski announced new travel rules at a press conference and, when asked when they would take effect, said 'sofort, unverzuglich'. East Berliners rushed to the checkpoints; the Wall opened.

The first free DDR elections (March 1990) brought a pro-unification government. Monetary union followed on 1 July 1990. The Unification Treaty was signed and the DDR formally joined the BRD on 3 October 1990.
The Two Plus Four Treaty between the DDR, BRD, USA, USSR, UK, and France resolved external aspects, restoring full sovereignty. NATO membership was extended to former DDR territory.
